snippet.title: The Day Before - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch this new trailer confirming The Day Before release date. Take a fast ride through the streets of the apocalypse in this latest The Day Before trailer for the upcoming open-world MMO survival game set in a deadly, post-pandemic America overrun by flesh-hungry infected and survivors killing each other for food, weapons, and cars. The Day Before will be available on November 10, 2023.

#IGN #Gaming #TheDayBefore
